findings.what: The E10 P4b(d) grep checks are under-specified, and the port path has no gate script. The team would improvise it at night under P8 autonomy. The fresh amanatar v10 source shows that a naive first-hit grep passes a bad port. It finds BIOHUB_REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = '27000' (line ~124) and a preset dict value of 27000.0 (line ~325), but a later runtime assignment sets 30600. Also, x138's reader defaults the validator to ON when the env line is missing: VALIDATOR_ENABLE = os.environ.get('BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE', '1') != '0'. So 'no line sets 1' is not the same as 'validator off'. tools/dummy_gates.validate_csv, the only P4b(e) tool, has three gaps. Duplicate node rows are silently merged, since the nodes dict is overwritten. Coordinates are never checked for finite values. The per-clip 1% node comparison against the author's CSV has no code.

findings.action: Before any trigger (this only tightens P4b, so it adds no mechanism and needs no new OK; log it with date -u), add tools/e10_port_gate.py plus tests. The script is read-only and never touches a kernel. Inputs: the pulled dir, our dummy output dir and the author's output dir. It prints PASS/FAIL per item: (1) metadata per P4b(a)/(b), including kernel_sources == [] (see PC10-03). (2) Source: every assignment of BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE sets '0', and at least one comes before the reader. Every os.environ assignment, os.environ.get fallback and preset-dict value of BIOHUB_REPAIR_DEADLINE_S equals 27000. There are no PPSWEEP/REWRITE/SWEEP gates, or the validator stays off. (3) The dummy log contains 'VALIDATOR: disabled (BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE=0).' and 'enabled=False', and has no 'Re-writing submission.csv' and no 'DEADLINE:' line. (4) validate_csv, plus a duplicate (dataset,node_id) check and finite x/y/z, run on both CSVs. (5) Per-clip node counts agree within 1%, with sha256 equality recorded as info. Tests: ext_x138 + exp56 dummy -> PASS; ext_optimized-biohub-max-score-v10 -> FAIL on (2). Extend the P4b(d) text: 'every assignment, not the first hit; the absent env line counts as ON'.

findings.what: P4b(b) covers dataset and model sources only. kernel_sources (another notebook's output used as input) is unchecked. That input floats to the source kernel's latest version, and it can carry a cached submission CSV or other test-derived files: the leaked 'biohub-sub-cache2' pattern seen on 26 Sep 08:27Z, repackaged as a notebook output. P3 bans 'cached CSV or test-derived dataset', but the mechanical checklist has no step that would catch it.

findings.what: E10 P1/P8 depend on things that are not written down. (a) P1 says 'diff the top-10 refs and lastRunTime against the previous check', but the previous snapshot exists only as prose in round notes. Round 9 wrote 'dateCreated and scoreDescending lists unchanged' with no file to diff against. (b) The research rounds, which are what trigger the checks now, stop at the R8 cutoff (27 Sep 12:00Z). Nothing records which process wakes the session for the ~6-hourly checks from 27 Sep 12:00Z to 29 Sep 00:00Z, most of them at night. P8's autonomous port is only as good as that detection. (c) P3's score read needs the browser: the KaggleApi kernel objects have no score field (verified: ref, title, last_run_time, total_votes, ...). A night-time trigger with Chrome disconnected cannot pass P3.
